judgment.rationale: Open issue #45453 already tracks the same Surface Copilot-key-to-Right-Ctrl limitation, including the editor warning and incomplete shortcut workaround behavior.
evidence: #45453 is titled “Cannot map Co-pilot key to Ctrl (Right) properly” and remains open.

inferences: The user-visible limitation likely lies in shortcut-target validation/editor behavior, but the duplicate tracker should own root-cause work.

initial_investigation: Reviewed Keyboard Manager KeyShortcutTextUnion and editor validation: shortcut remaps can target a key in data, but a modifier in shortcut controls is treated as requiring another action key.
